# alya — learn spanish. by doomscrolling.

> ALYA is a Spanish immersion feed for iOS. Scroll short real-world videos, tap any unfamiliar word for instant translation, save vocabulary for review, respond to contextual prompts, and grow your companion as you learn. Free to download with ALYA Plus for unlimited immersion.

**What is ALYA?** ALYA is a Spanish immersion feed for iOS. Scroll short real-world videos, tap any unfamiliar word for instant translation, save vocabulary for review, respond to contextual prompts, and grow your companion as you learn. Beginner to advanced, with translations and glosses so you always understand in context.

**Tagline:** learn spanish. by doomscrolling.
**Product loop:** scroll → tap to understand → save words → earn stars → grow ALYA.
**Subscription:** Free + ALYA Plus (Monthly $4.99/month, Annual $29.99/year = $2.50/month, save 50% vs monthly, via App Store, 7 days free for eligible new users, iOS only).
**Available:** iOS App Store. App Store ID: 6758835552. App: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/alya-learn-spanish-with-ai/id6758835552
**Website:** https://alyacompanion.xyz
**Full reference:** https://alyacompanion.xyz/llms-full.txt (complete FAQ, pricing, topics, comparisons, blog summaries)
**Last updated:** 2026-09-12
**Contact:** amber@alyacompanion.xyz
**Social:** https://twitter.com/alyacompanion (@alyacompanion)

## Key Features

- Vertical immersion feed: short Spanish videos, 20 on open, refill before you run out
- Tap-to-translate with synchronized Spanish transcript + English meaning
- Per-word glosses: tap any unfamiliar word for exact meaning
- Tap-to-hear pronunciation (Deepgram Aura-2 selena-es), 0.75–1.5x playback speeds
- Save vocabulary and review phrases, unlimited with Plus
- Contextual response prompts that make you produce Spanish, not just recognize it
- Companion: earn stars, grow energy / bond / curiosity, unlock rooms, outfits, rewards
- Levels: beginner, intermediate, advanced — feed adapts to you
- 20 topics: Travel, Food, Culture, Music, Comedy, Family, Work, Sports, Shopping, Health, Cooking, Fashion, Gaming, Animals, Beauty, Business, Exercise, Relationships, Technology, Morning Routine
- Explore filters: levels, grammar (Questions, Present/Past tense, Commands, Polite phrases, Conversation), sources (Anime → Lesson), Shorts vs Videos
- Personalized onboarding plan: goals, level, challenges, 5–30 min/day, reminders
- Streaks, achievements, activity history, progress dashboard
- ALYA Plus: Unlimited Immersion, Advanced Explanations, Unlimited Vocabulary, Customization

## What Kind of Spanish Does ALYA Teach?

Real-world Spanish from native content — street interviews, vlogs, food, travel, music, culture. Beginner to advanced, with translations and glosses so you always understand in context.

## How ALYA Compares

- vs. Duolingo: Duolingo drills vocabulary with gamified exercises. ALYA gives you real native videos with instant understanding. Drill sentences vs real content.
- vs. ChatGPT: ChatGPT can explain Spanish if you prompt it right. ALYA is a ready-made feed — no prompting, just scroll, tap, and learn.
- vs. Babbel: Babbel follows a structured curriculum. ALYA teaches through immersion — real videos matched to your level.
- vs. HelloTalk: HelloTalk needs a human partner and scheduling. ALYA is available instantly, endless content, no pressure.
- vs. Praktika: Praktika uses AI avatars for speaking drills. ALYA uses real native videos + a companion that grows with you.
- vs. italki: italki rents a tutor by the hour. ALYA gives you daily input so tutors become 10x more valuable.
- vs. Pimsleur: Pimsleur drills pronunciation with audio lessons. ALYA trains comprehension with real videos you can tap.

## FAQ (short answers)

- What is ALYA? A Spanish immersion feed for iOS: real videos, tap-to-translate, saved vocabulary, companion that grows.
- Is ALYA free? Free to download on iOS. ALYA Plus membership unlocks the feed, with a 7-day free trial when eligible.
- How is ALYA different from Duolingo? Duolingo drills sentences. ALYA builds understanding from real native videos.
- Do I need Spanish already? No. Beginner clips include full translations and per-word glosses.
